case_a1_done4: An advantages block: equipment, safe cleaning products and experienced staff
case_a1_done7: Responsive layout for phones, tablets and desktops
case_a1_result1: The client received a modern one-page site with a responsive layout and a clear service structure, optimized for high conversion and fast loading.

case_ai1c_format: Web service with an AI agent
case_ai1c_about1: The task was an assistant for accountants that you can write to in plain language: it finds what is needed in the 1C database, prepares documents and explains what it did.
case_ai1c_done_intro: We built a web service with a chat where an AI agent works with the 1C database:
case_ai1c_done1: It knows its way around the database structure and finds the right catalogs, documents and registers itself
case_ai1c_done2: It answers questions about the data: documents, postings, counterparties, prices and reports
case_ai1c_done3: It creates and edits documents: purchases and sales, HR documents, payroll
case_ai1c_done4: It parses uploaded files and works with their contents
case_ai1c_done5: Before writing to 1C it shows what it is about to do and waits for the user to confirm
case_ai1c_done6: It audits what is already recorded and finds problems in documents and postings
case_ai1c_done7: It keeps an action log and conversation history and supports several 1C databases
case_ai1c_done8: It runs either on a cloud language model or on a model hosted on a dedicated server
case_ai1c_result1: The result is a service where a task is solved in a conversation: the user writes what is needed, the agent finds the data, prepares the document and saves it to 1C after confirmation.
case_ai1c_result2: Every change to the database goes through confirmation and stays in the log, so it is always clear what the agent did and when.
